notes.text:
を follows a noun or place. It indicates that that noun is the direct object of the verb, that the place is the place of departure, or that the place was passed through.



を is romanized as "wo" or "o".



Amatuka said this below.

comments.text: Note : The object marker を is said 'o' but may be written as either 'wo' or 'o' depending on romaji system used.
comments.html: Note : The object marker を is said 'o' but may be written as either 'wo' or 'o' depending on romaji system used.

comments.text:
The three uses of を  are 

1. objective / target (目的) 

2. area passed through (通過点) 

3. departure point (出発点)
